title: Wooded Get-away in West Nashville
description:
My home is located on three forested acres in West Nashville.    It is  15 minutes to downtown, Vanderbilt and Belmont Universities; 5 minutes to the Warren Parks, Cheekwood Botanical Gardens and Belle Meade Plantation; 5 minutes to I-40; great views, restaurants and dining!  You’ll love my place because of the park-like setting, convenient location, and a great neighborhood for walking/jogging. My place is good for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers, and families (with kids).

The space
1 King size bed and 1 Queen sleeper sofa separated by a room divider.  This is a full apartment in the lower level of my home with a separate entrance. There are no stairs to climb and handicap bars installed in the shower for those who need them.  Parking for the apartment is just outside the door.   I have plenty of toys on hand for children.   There is also a  playpen and two children's cots with bedding located in the closet in the apartment.  A child's table and chairs is also available if desired.

Guest access
You have access to the apartment  only located in the lower level of my home with your own  private entrance.

Other things to note
Laundry facilities are free for your use.
